title: Synthwerk CloudEvent envelope
description: CloudEvents 1.0.2 in JSON format, with the Synthwerk rules and extensions. The data schema depends on `type` (see events/catalog.yaml).

specversion.description: CloudEvents spec version. 1.0.2 is a patch of 1.0, so the value is "1.0".

id.description: UUIDv7. Also the Nats-Msg-Id for dedupe.

type.description: dev.synthwerk.<domain>.<entity>.<verb>.v<N>. The verb is in the past tense.

subject.description: Id of the main entity, for example the conversation id.

time.description: When the fact happened (RFC 3339). Producers send UTC.

tenantid.description: Extension. Tenant (customer org) the fact belongs to. Absent for platform facts.

traceparent.description: Extension. W3C Trace Context of the request that caused the fact.

actor.description: Extension. Who caused the fact: user:<sub>, service:<name> or system. Never an email or a name.

data.description: The fact. Validate it with the data schema of `type`.
